g.text: A: boxes span the interquartile range, whiskers the 5th to 95th percentile, open circles are means; human 48,162, mouse 28,918, rat 10,258 proteins. B: boxes span the
interquartile range, whiskers the 5th to 95th percentile, open circles are means; proteins by highest tier: GOLD 34,883, SILVER 31,549, BRONZE 20,906; no interval is
drawn on the means; the eta-squared interval is the stored protein-bootstrap interval. C: boxes span the interquartile range, whiskers the 5th to 95th percentile, open
circles are means; proteins by highest tier: GOLD 34,883, SILVER 31,549, BRONZE 20,906; no interval is drawn on the means; the secondary index is built from the tiers'
own publications, which is why it was not used for matching. D: counts per bin. E: 48,162 human proteins; annotation presence is a proxy for the outcome, not an
independent variable. F: 48,162 human proteins, 18,757 gene clusters; Pharos target classes, V50 index. G: GOLD and BRONZE sites in P-all and P-human; 95%
gene-cluster intervals. H: 48,162 human proteins, 18,757 gene clusters.
